# Component reference

Every component below is available in any MarkUP document. Plugins can add more.

## Callouts

### note

Note callout — useful information that readers should know, even when skimming.

**Syntax:** `:::note`

**Label** (optional): Custom title. Defaults to “Note”.

| Attribute | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `collapsible` | boolean | — | Render the callout collapsed behind its title. |

```markup
:::note
The body is regular **MarkUP**.
:::
```

### tip

Tip callout — helpful advice for doing things better or more easily.

**Syntax:** `:::tip`

**Label** (optional): Custom title. Defaults to “Tip”.

| Attribute | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `collapsible` | boolean | — | Render the callout collapsed behind its title. |

```markup
:::tip
The body is regular **MarkUP**.
:::
```

### important

Important callout — key information readers need to achieve their goal.

**Syntax:** `:::important`

**Label** (optional): Custom title. Defaults to “Important”.

| Attribute | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `collapsible` | boolean | — | Render the callout collapsed behind its title. |

```markup
:::important
The body is regular **MarkUP**.
:::
```

### warning

Warning callout — urgent information that needs immediate attention to avoid problems.

**Syntax:** `:::warning`

**Label** (optional): Custom title. Defaults to “Warning”.

| Attribute | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `collapsible` | boolean | — | Render the callout collapsed behind its title. |

```markup
:::warning
The body is regular **MarkUP**.
:::
```

### caution

Caution callout — advises about risks or negative outcomes of certain actions.

**Syntax:** `:::caution`

**Label** (optional): Custom title. Defaults to “Caution”.

| Attribute | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `collapsible` | boolean | — | Render the callout collapsed behind its title. |

```markup
:::caution
The body is regular **MarkUP**.
:::
```

## Layout

### card

A bordered surface that groups related content. Several cards in a row inside `columns` make a grid.

**Syntax:** `:::card`

**Label** (optional): Card title.

| Attribute | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `href` | string | — | Makes the title a link. |
| `icon` | string | — | A short symbol shown before the title. |

```markup
:::card[Installation]{href=installation.md}
MarkUP needs Node.js 22.12 or newer.
:::
```

### columns

Lays out its `column` children side by side. Columns stack on narrow screens.

**Syntax:** `:::columns`

| Attribute | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `gap` | "none" \| "small" \| "medium" \| "large" | `medium` | Space between columns. |
| `align` | "start" \| "center" \| "end" \| "stretch" | `stretch` | Vertical alignment of the columns. |

May only contain `column`.

```markup
::::columns
:::column
Left
:::
:::column
Right
:::
::::
```

### column

One column of a `columns` layout.

**Syntax:** `:::column`

| Attribute | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `span` | integer (1–12) | `1` | Relative width compared to sibling columns. |

Must be placed directly inside `columns`.

### tabs

A set of tabbed panels. Each panel is a `tab` child; works without JavaScript.

**Syntax:** `:::tabs`

May only contain `tab`.

~~~~markup
::::tabs
:::tab[Command]
```sh
markup build docs --out site
```
:::
:::tab[Configuration]
```json
{ "out": "site" }
```
:::
::::
~~~~

### tab

One panel of a `tabs` group. The label is the tab title.

**Syntax:** `:::tab`

**Label** (required): Tab title.

| Attribute | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `selected` | boolean | — | Select this tab initially instead of the first one. |

Must be placed directly inside `tabs`.

## Content

### details

A collapsible section. The label is the always-visible summary.

**Syntax:** `:::details`

**Label** (optional): Summary text. Defaults to “Details”.

| Attribute | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `open` | boolean | — | Start expanded. |

```markup
:::details[How does it work?]
The body is hidden until the reader expands it.
:::
```

### figure

Self-contained content — usually an image, diagram or code — with an optional caption.

**Syntax:** `:::figure`

**Label** (optional): Caption.

| Attribute | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `align` | "left" \| "center" \| "right" | `center` | Horizontal alignment. |

~~~~markup
:::figure[Building a folder]
```sh
markup build docs --out site
```
:::
~~~~

### progress

A progress bar. Use it as a block (`::progress`) or inline (`:progress`).

**Syntax:** `::progress`, `:progress`

**Label** (optional): Text shown next to the bar.

| Attribute | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `value` | number | required | Current value. |
| `max` | number (≥ 0) | `100` | Value that represents completion. |
| `variant` | "default" \| "success" \| "warning" \| "danger" | `default` | Colour. |

```markup
::progress[Translation]{value=72}
```

## Data

### chart

A chart rendered to static SVG. The body is MarkUP Data: either `data` (one series of `label: value` pairs) or `labels` plus `series`.

**Syntax:** `:::chart` · body: MarkUP Data

**Label** (optional): Chart title (same as the `title` key).

| Attribute | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `type` | "bar" \| "line" \| "area" \| "pie" \| "donut" | `bar` | Kind of chart. |
| `title` | string | — | Title shown above the chart. |
| `unit` | string | — | Unit appended to values, e.g. `%` or ` ms`. |
| `height` | number (120–1200) | `280` | Height in pixels. |
| `stacked` | boolean | — | Stack series instead of grouping them (bar and area). |
| `legend` | boolean | — | Show the legend. Defaults to true when there are several series. |

**Single series**

```markup
:::chart
type: bar
title: Favourite languages
data:
  Python: 80
  JavaScript: 60
  Rust: 40
:::
```

**Several series**

```markup
:::chart{type=line unit=k}
labels: [Q1, Q2, Q3, Q4]
series:
  - name: 2025
    values: [12, 18, 15, 24]
  - name: 2026
    values: [16, 22, 27, 31]
:::
```

## Navigation

### toc

A table of contents generated from the document’s headings.

**Syntax:** `::toc`

**Label** (optional): Title shown above the list.

| Attribute | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `depth` | integer (1–6) | `3` | Deepest heading level to include. |
| `from` | integer (1–6) | `2` | Shallowest heading level to include. |

```markup
::toc[On this page]{depth=3}
```

## Inline

### badge

A small status label.

**Syntax:** `:badge`

**Label** (required): Badge text.

| Attribute | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `variant` | "neutral" \| "info" \| "success" \| "warning" \| "danger" | `neutral` | Colour. |

```markup
Status: :badge[stable]{variant=success}
```

### kbd

A keyboard shortcut. Keys separated by `+` are rendered individually.

**Syntax:** `:kbd`

**Label** (required): Keys, e.g. `Ctrl+Shift+P`.

```markup
Press :kbd[Ctrl+S] to save.
```

### abbr

An abbreviation with its expansion shown on hover.

**Syntax:** `:abbr`

**Label** (required): The abbreviation.

| Attribute | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `title` | string | required | The expanded form. |

```markup
:abbr[AST]{title="Abstract syntax tree"}
```
